fields.description: Issue features continued investigative coverage of the Miami Retreat, including allegations of patient mistreatment, questionable billing practices (private patients listed as county/charity), and calls for official investigation; includes references to Disabled American Veterans actions and discussion of Crime Commission activity. Also covers local civic and political issues such as proposed water-rate increases and municipal decision-making, pollution concerns in Biscayne Bay and the Miami River, and business/competition disputes involving chain grocery advertising and pricing. Additional content includes a report on oil activity west of Miami near Everglades City and commentary/columns, letters to the editor, and entertainment/nightlife advertising.
